response.sql: SELECT s.riskeval, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_scan_minute FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sc.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND s.riskeval IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.riskeval;

assumptions.assumption: chronotag is compared as text, and BETWEEN is inclusive of both bounds.

Unmatched scans are dropped by an inner join, and sites with a NULL riskeval are excluded. Rows with NULL gbsize or spanmin produce a NULL ratio that AVG ignores. A spanmin of 0 is also treated as missing via NULLIF so it does not raise a division-by-zero error; the request does not say how to handle zero.
The average is the mean of each scan's own gbsize/spanmin ratio, with every scan weighted equally.

alternatives.interpretation: Ratio of totals: for each riskeval, total file size in GB divided by total scan minutes, using only scans where both gbsize and spanmin are present, rather than the mean of per-scan ratios.
alternatives.sql: SELECT s.riskeval, SUM(sc.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) AS gb_per_scan_minute FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sc.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND s.riskeval IS NOT NULL AND sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.riskeval;
